saintapediasuggest-desc: Lets readers suggest a correction to a specific Cargo field stored for a page, and gives editors a dashboard to triage those suggestions.
saintapediasuggest-panel-subtitle: Spotted something wrong in this page's data? Tell us which field and what it should say. An editor reviews every suggestion.
saintapediasuggest-error-norow: That entry no longer exists on this page.
saintapediasuggest-comment-placeholder: A source or a short explanation helps reviewers.
saintapediasuggest-email-placeholder: Only used if we need to follow up
saintapediasuggest-success-body: Your suggestion has been sent for review.
saintapediasuggest-error-generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
saintapediasuggest-error-ratelimit: You have sent the maximum number of suggestions for today. Please try again tomorrow.
saintapediasuggest-error-nofield: That field cannot be suggested on this page.
saintapediasuggest-error-unchanged: That is the same as the value already stored.
saintapediasuggest-error-namespace: Suggestions are not enabled in this namespace.
saintapediasuggest-error-disabled: Suggestions are currently turned off on this wiki.
saintapediasuggest-error-captcha: The captcha was not solved correctly. Please try again.
saintapediasuggest-error-captcha-unavail: Suggestions are temporarily unavailable because the captcha is not configured. Please tell an administrator.
saintapediasuggest-dashboard-intro: Reader-submitted corrections to Cargo field values. Reviewing a suggestion does not change any data — copy the proposed value, edit the source template or page, then mark the suggestion actioned.
saintapediasuggest-bulk-confirm: Change the status of {{PLURAL:$1|$1 suggestion|all $1 selected suggestions}}?
saintapediasuggest-duplicates-heading: Also reported by {{PLURAL:$1|$1 other reader|$1 other readers}}
saintapediasuggest-flash-token: Your session expired. Please try again.
right-saintapediasuggest-view: View and triage reader field suggestions
right-saintapediasuggest-viewemail: View the contact email on a field suggestion
action-saintapediasuggest-viewemail: view contact emails on field suggestions
apihelp-saintapediasuggest-description: Submit a suggested change to one Cargo field stored for a page.
apihelp-saintapediasuggest-summary: Submit a suggested change to one Cargo field stored for a page.
apihelp-saintapediasuggest-param-pageid: Page ID whose Cargo row is being corrected.
apihelp-saintapediasuggest-param-table: Cargo table holding the field. Must be allow-listed by $wgSaintapediaSuggestTables.
apihelp-saintapediasuggest-param-field: Cargo field to correct. Must be allow-listed and present in the table's schema.
apihelp-saintapediasuggest-param-rowid: Cargo _ID of the row being corrected. Required when the page has more than one row in that table; filled in automatically for a single-row table.
apihelp-saintapediasuggest-param-suggest: The value the reader proposes instead.
apihelp-saintapediasuggest-param-email: Optional contact email, stored only when the email field is enabled.
apihelp-saintapediasuggest-param-captcha: hCaptcha response token, when a captcha is required.
apihelp-saintapediasuggest-example-1: Suggest a new phone number for page 1 in the Parishes table
echo-pref-tooltip-saintapediasuggest: Notify me when a reader suggests a correction to a field.
notification-header-saintapediasuggest-n: A reader suggested a correction on $1.
saintapediasuggest-freshness-applied-tip: The stored value already matches this suggestion.
saintapediasuggest-freshness-changed-tip: This field has changed since the suggestion was made, so the value shown as "currently" is out of date.
saintapediasuggest-freshness-unapplied-t: This was marked actioned, but the stored value is still the one the reader reported. The change may not have been made.
